data.name: Aiz
data.gender_notes: Aiz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'A-Z-A', which means to help, support, or assist. In Islamic history, 'Aiz is associated with the story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) and his brothers who sold him into slavery but later regretted their actions and sought his forgiveness. The name Aiz symbolizes the power of repentance and the importance of seeking forgiveness.

data.etymology: Aiz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Help, Support.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aiz total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
